---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest a new tool, viewer capability, or improvement
title: "[Feature] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

**The idea**
What you would like Analyser to do.

**Why**
The problem it solves or the use case behind it.

**Keep in mind**
Analyser runs entirely in the browser with no backend and never uploads files.
Ideas that fit that model are much easier to land. If your idea would need a
server or would send file data off-device, say so - it may not be a fit.

**Anything else**
Mockups, references, or examples from other tools.
